mapper.insert: INSERT INTO calendar_tasks (e_idx, task_date, task_description, created_at) VALUES (#{e_idx}, #{task_date}, #{task_description}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM calendar_tasks WHERE e_idx = #{e_idx} ORDER BY task_date DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM calendar_tasks WHERE e_idx = #{e_idx} AND task_date = #{task_date}
